# Ticker Screener

> Ticker Screener – Live Watchlist & Ticker is a free browser extension for Chrome and Firefox.
> Live NYSE/Nasdaq watchlist, S&P 500 / Nasdaq / Dow ticker tape, P/E-based
> stock verdicts and price alerts inside every browser tab. US prices show in $; 9 more
> economies keep native currencies. No account, no backend  data stays in browser local storage.

- Homepage: https://vishwaroopg.github.io/Screener-Extension/
- Blog: https://vishwaroopg.github.io/Screener-Extension/blog/
- Install (Chrome): https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/screener-pro-%E2%80%93-live-watch/pfaifjhdbnpfdjieppkhciemgccbpifi?authuser=0&hl=en
- Telegram (Global Market Pulse): https://t.me/GlobalMarketPulseLive
- Developer portfolio: https://www.vishwaroopgalgali.com/

## Features (what questions this answers)

- Live US watchlist in the browser side panel (NYSE/Nasdaq price, day change, sparklines, market cap, switchable P/E / Div Yld / ROCE / ROE / P/B column, Screener-style 51.5 formatting with auto P/B). Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+S (Command+Shift+S on Mac).
- Watchlist power: color tags + tag filter, Smart Focus blue-dot (big >5% move, unusual swing, near 52w high/low) with Focus-only view and per-stock mute, bulk Select mode with header Select-All (tag / move / delete), preserved horizontal scroll.
- One-click import from Zerodha Kite, Screener.in, TradingView: Detect from open tab (read only on click, checkbox preview), paste list, or upload CSV/TXT; auto-resolve + deduped merge.
- Live ticker tape on every website (S&P 500, Nasdaq, Dow, watchlist; pause, 0.5x–3.0x speed, per-site disable; % change, amount change, or both combined like +$5.20 (+0.37%)). v2.6.3 silk engine: time-based 60Hz/120Hz-identical speed, seamless both-direction loop, jitter-free background-only flashes, fixed speed popover + ESC, dark-mode readable dropdowns.
- Markets tab: opens on the USA, plus UK, India, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Germany, France, Australia, Canada — Market Mood gauge on top (live Tickertape MMI for India, CNN Fear & Greed for the USA, market-data proxy elsewhere; hover arcs for zones, ⓘ lists factors), whole-market advance/decline breadth (Nifty 500 for India via Moneycontrol, NYSE + Nasdaq for USA via WSJ, 10-min cache), index heatmap, top gainers/losers, World Bank macro tiles (inflation, unemployment, GDP growth, GDP per capita).
- Smart verdicts from P/E + ROCE (undervalued / overvalued / high risk) + custom price alerts with notifications.
- v2.7.0 Fundamentals Depth on every stock search: free checklist score /10, SWOT from Screener pros/cons, forensic red-flags, promoter/FII/DII/public shareholding with trend, concall transcripts with PPT links, research shortcuts (Screener, Tickertape, Trendlyne Superstars) + one-click PDF.
- Add stocks from any webpage via right-click; Screener.in Top Ratios sync when logged in.
- Multiple portfolios, CSV export, stock news feed with publisher thumbnails, dark mode, interactive 1M–MAX charts (hardened popup buttons + Read more/less), dashboard refresh button, full-screen tab view (fullscreen header button).

## Data sources

- Prices/indices/charts: Yahoo Finance. US fundamentals: Finviz (with Yahoo Finance fallback). Indian ratios: Screener.in (login required for custom ratios). Market breadth: Moneycontrol (India Nifty 500), WSJ Markets Diary (USA NYSE + Nasdaq). Market mood: Tickertape MMI API (India), CNN Fear & Greed (USA). Macro: World Bank. News: Google News RSS.
